method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the person subjected to an alleged contravention of the Anti-Discrimination Act 1991 who complains (alone or as a member of a class), with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05; the focus is commencement: s 2 as passed, checked provision by provision against the Anti-Discrimination Act 1991 deposited beside it, with the 1 July 2025 group (deferred on that evidence) asked as two facts in every question that turns on it. Dates in one module (built-in date functions, no daydate), s 2 and the deposited-text check in a second, the complainant's exported questions in a third (each calling a rule defined beside it), worked cases in a fourth; one regulative rule (the s 138(1) complaint period) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Respect at Work and Other Matters Amendment Act 2024 (Qld), act-2024-047, as passed (published on the register 2024-09-19; not in the in-force collection on 2026-11-06), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-2024-047.txt (text sha256 004b8e9efa6e0ad50c0eb0165bef58ad31c60cda3d1484384a0439e68186f813 of the committed file, per its meta.json), converted from the Queensland Legislation HTML view. Read against the Anti-Discrimination Act 1991 (Qld), act-1991-085, the version in force from 2025-05-19 (current on 2026-11-06), deposited at ../../../anti-discrimination-act-1991/registers/source-bundle/act-1991-085.txt.

seat: the complainant: the person who was subjected to an alleged contravention of the Anti-Discrimination Act 1991 (discrimination, sexual harassment, harassment on the basis of sex, a hostile work environment, vilification) and complains, or may complain, to the Queensland Human Rights Commissioner, alone or as a member of a class in a representative complaint (rawq-claimant.l4)

checks.command: l4 run rawq-dates.l4 ; l4 run rawq-commencement.l4 ; l4 run rawq-claimant.l4 ; l4 run rawq-cases-claimant.l4
checks.result: 157 assertions written, 157 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Commencement and the complaint machinery. In: s 2 (every provision, by group), checked against the deposited Anti-Discrimination Act 1991; and, as amended by part 2 and inserted by s 51, ss 7 (attributes, with schedule 1 race as s 52 widens it), 120 and 120A-120E (harassment on the basis of sex), 124E (hostile work environment), 131I (positive duty, and that a breach is not a complaint), 134(1)(b) and new 134(2) with s 284 (agents), 138 with s 283 (the complaint period), 146 (representative complaints), 148, 149, 195, 196 (separate complaints, opting out), 204, 205 with s 285A (and the 1991 Act's s 285AA) (burden of proof), 209(5) (costs) and 285 (existing representative complaints). Out: ss 10, 11, 11A and the rest of the substantive Part 2 amendments (each named in NOTES.md: ss 4-6, 8-17, 19-21, 23, 24, 26-28 in part, 30, 32-46 in part, 49, 50, 52 in part), vilification (ch 4 pt 4), the commissioner's investigation and compliance powers (ch 7 pt 1A), ss 286-287, and parts 3 to 11 and schedule 2 (amendments of other Acts) beyond their commencement. Reasons in NOTES.md.
